subject: physics

hotspots.label: Cart A
hotspots.description: The left cart whose mass and velocity combine into momentum.
hotspots.colorHint: Amber cart on the left end of the track.
hotspots.function: Carries Cart A with a tunable mass and velocity.

hotspots.label: Cart B
hotspots.description: The right cart, facing Cart A across the track.
hotspots.colorHint: Blue cart on the right end of the track.
hotspots.function: Carries Cart B with a tunable mass and velocity.

hotspots.label: Mass Sliders
hotspots.description: Sliders set each cart's mass in kg — one knob of the momentum product.
hotspots.function: Sets the mass input to the momentum equation.

hotspots.label: Velocity Arrows
hotspots.description: Arrows attached to the carts showing their velocity — length and direction become momentum's direction.
hotspots.function: Shows the velocity that gives momentum its size and direction.

hotspots.label: Momentum Values
hotspots.description: Each cart's live momentum (mass × velocity) in kg·m/s.
hotspots.function: Displays the computed momentum on each cart.

hotspots.label: Conservation Banner
hotspots.description: The floating banner showing total momentum — identical before and after every collision.
hotspots.colorHint: A wide banner floating above the track.
hotspots.function: Verifies that total momentum is conserved across collisions.

visualStyleNotes: Warm off-white paper background, soft vignette, no floor grid. A straight warm track with two carts (amber and blue), coral velocity arrows, green mass sliders, and a floating conservation banner. Saturated color on arrows, sliders, banner only. Neutral studio light, no bloom, no emissive.
materialNotes: Metallic-roughness, metallic=0. Track: warm-grey cylinder/rail (roughness ~0.5). Cart A: amber rounded box with wheels; Cart B: blue. Arrows: matte coral prisms. Banner: soft paper white with green total. Sliders warm-grey.
assetBrief:
SUBJECT: momentum as mass × velocity, vector, and conserved across collisions on a track.

GEOMETRY: a straight track along +x (length ~5) with two carts (each ~0.5 long) at ±1.1, facing each other. Velocity arrows above each cart, small mass sliders on pedestals beside the track, a floating conservation banner overhead.

INTERACTION: sliders set mass (1-8 kg) and speed (0-4 m/s, direction buttons); Go runs the carts and plays an elastic collision; the banner holds total constant with a flash effect when the math matches.

LAYERS: carts+track; sliders; arrows; readouts+banner.

NAMED NODES: TrackRail, Cart_A, Cart_B, MassSlider_A, MassSlider_B, VelocityArrow_A, VelocityArrow_B, MomentumBadge_A, MomentumBadge_B, ConservationBanner. 7-11k tris.
